description: In the current public registry only operation=get_latest is exposed; it returns the latest public signal when available and does not change state. Disposition operations are not exposed by this configuration. If you need to challenge an Hourkeeper ruling, use challenge_hourkeeper_decision instead. Preserve an unavailable/empty result rather than inventing a signal.

idempotency_key.description: Stable caller-generated key for a disposition receipt; required on write operations, not on get_latest.

message_id.description: Public signal message ID returned by get_latest; required for a disposition receipt.

operation.description: Only get_latest is enabled in this runtime: retrieve the latest public signal, if one is available. Disposition operations are not exposed by this registry configuration.

reason.description: Optional disposition explanation, up to 1000 characters; recorded with challenge/decline/safety-block operations.

name: receive_founder_signal
title: Retrieve or acknowledge a Founder Signal
